description: List a GitHub repository's pull requests from https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pulls. state=open (default, 未关闭) | closed (已关闭) | merged (已合并) | all (全部) filters by status (note: closed maps to GitHub's Closed tab which also includes merged PRs; each item's state field distinguishes them); sort=created (default, 按创建时间) | updated (按更新时间) | comments (按评论数) orders the list. Returns PR cards with number, title, state, author, labels, comment count, review decision (Review required / Approved / Changes requested), draft flag, and state-specific timestamps (created_at for open/draft, closed_at for closed, merged_at for merged). The page renders 25 PRs per page; higher limits paginate via ?page=N and partial=true is returned when truncated. Reads the rendered pulls tab (SSR DOM + hydrated comment/review fields); no login required.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as owner/repo (e.g. facebook/react) or its full URL (e.g. https://github.com/facebook/react). Repository renames are followed via redirect (facebook/react -> react/react).（仓库标识：owner/repo 或完整 URL）

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Pull request state filter: open (default, 未关闭) | closed (已关闭) | merged (已合并) | all (全部). Maps to the pulls page tabs: closed = GitHub's Closed tab (includes both unmerged-closed and merged PRs), all = every state mixed, open includes draft PRs.（PR 状态过滤：open=未关闭 / closed=已关闭 / merged=已合并 / all=全部。注：closed 对应 GitHub Closed tab，含未合并关闭与已合并 PR，靠每项 state 字段区分）

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: created (default, 按创建时间) | updated (按更新时间) | comments (按评论数). Maps to the page sort dropdown: created = Newest, updated = Recently updated, comments = Most commented.（排序方式：created=按创建时间 / updated=按更新时间 / comments=按评论数）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum pull requests to return (1-100, default 20). The first page renders 25; higher limits paginate via ?page=N and partial=true is returned when the list is truncated by this limit.（条数上限，默认 20；每页 25 条，超过则分页加载，partial 指示是否被截断）
